text:
Situation: Cefazolin sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2018-11-30. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been listed for 95 months. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 11 to 23 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 970483 ended 2016-04-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2016-07-13, which was 962 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2018-11-30. A prior inspection 876911 ended 2014-03-28 and was classified OAI with six observations including absence of written procedures and deviations from laboratory control requirements. FDA issued a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21 to the same facility. Subsequent inspections 940389, 1125050, 1254066, and 1203129 were all classified VAI. FDA's records do not state that any inspection caused the shortage.

Our position: Supply is critically low. The rule-ranked alternate manufacturer is Samson Medical Technologies, L.L.C., which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Four additional manufacturers also are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with Samson Medical Technologies, L.L.C. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with Sandoz Inc — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with WG Critical Care, LLC — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with A-S Medication Solutions — requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with Apotex Corp. — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting resolution of the original shortage.
